ValidationRule.description: Require Category and SubCategory for Universal Learner Courses when closing cases excluding Status Closed : SPAM , Closed : Forwarded excluding System Administrator
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( (CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Universal Learner Courses" ), OR ( (ISBLANK(TEXT( Category__c ))), (ISBLANK(TEXT( Sub_Category__c ))) ), ($User.ProfileId <> "00ed00000017Iob"), OR ( ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Cancellation"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Customer Self-Resolved"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Customer Unresponsive"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Duplicate"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: No Show"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Resolved")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide Category and Sub-Category when Functional Group is Universal Learner Courses
